title: Credential meter
description: Four quiet segments track which password requirements are satisfied.
useCase: Show the remaining requirements while a user chooses a credential.
interaction: Type a password and toggle its visibility.
reducedMotion: Requirement states update instantly; the meter has no animated travel.
limitations: A local policy checklist, not a password strength estimate or authentication system.
look: Near-black green-tinted page with a dark rounded password field, four thin grey meter segments, a two-column requirements list and a divider above status text.
motion: Typing fills one of four meter segments per satisfied rule, left to right, fading each to mint green over 180 ms while matching rule labels brighten and gain a check.
adapt: Policy is the `rules` array (label plus `met` test) and `count` drives the `.meter i` segments via `data-met`; the only motion is a 0.18 s colour transition in CSS. Replace the rules with your policy and wire `value` to your form.
